title: The Spear Hero's Parallel World
text: Today is a fun hunting trip with Myne and the others. I’ve been riding out the waves and organizing my quests, items, and weapons, so I’m all set. I’ve finished Class Up, so now… maybe I should head over to Zeltoble to pick up some good weapons.

I, Motoyasu Kitamura, had left the castle town with everyone else to take the next step in our journey. As we approached the Wave-damaged area currently under reconstruction, I spotted someone. Naofumi was making a white and cherry-pink ostrich-like bird—a Filolial—pull a handcart, looking thoroughly bored.
So surreal! I know exactly how lame this is because I’m familiar with it! I couldn’t help but burst out laughing. What the hell is that rapist doing?
“Bwah! What the hell is that?! Haha, oh man, that’s right up my alley. Bwahahahahahahaha!”

Oh man! I really can’t stop laughing! Wahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha! Myne and the others join in, pointing at Naofumi and the handcart and laughing. I mean, even if he is a rapist, why on earth is a hero hauling luggage in such a lame outfit?!
“What’s with the sudden outburst, Motoyasu?”
Naofumi furrows his brow in annoyance and asks me. That’s exactly what I was going to say! Just how lame are you, anyway?
“B-but! It’s just sooooo lame!”
“What is?”
“Did you just start peddling goods or something? People with no money really are desperate. Even the bird is sooooo lame!”

Lame, lame! I mean, I can tell right away that this Filolial is way cheaper than the ones the folks at the castle have. What are you even doing using a cheapie with absolutely no pedigree? It’s only natural that the quality suffers with something like this, right? I wonder if you even have any motivation—but I guess this is just the level Naofumi operates at.
That’s what I’m thinking, but Naofumi just looks like he’s lost in thought—silent and distant. Oh well, I’ll just keep looking at the Filolial. The color scheme really is lame!

There’s a certain beauty to solid colors. Two colors—and even then, only the tips of the feathers are different? How subtle are these shades supposed to be? I mean, using a bird—a Filolial—instead of a horse? Plus, the speed at which it pulls the cart is a bit slow.
“Sooo lameeeeeee! It’s a bird, not a horse, and what’s up with this color? It’s supposed to be white, but there’s a hint of pale pink mixed in—it’s supposed to be pure white, right? And come on!”
“I don’t know what’s ‘normal’…”
Oh man, I laughed so hard tears started streaming down my face. Right after that!
“Guaaaaah!”
Filolial had kicked me in the groin faster than I could even register it. An excruciating pain pierced the top of my head!
That’s right… this pain—I remember it now!
Spinning around in a whirlwind, I recalled everything that had happened so far, as well as what would happen in the future… my days with Filo-tan. This is… the moment I first met Filo-tan!
I broke my fall mid-spin, landed smoothly with a thud, and turned around. Father, who had been grinning, seemed to click his tongue.
“Bububuuu.”
The Crimson Swine is making a fuss about something, but I don’t care. Ah, more importantly, this pleasant pain piercing through my body… this is proof of Filo-tan’s love for me—a kick to the groin!
“I’ve remembered!”
“Huh? Remembered? Really?”
I rush over to Father and Filo-tan at top speed and stroke Filo-tan’s feathers. It seems I’m even pulling my level and such from the future.
“Gwaaaaaa!?”
Filo-tan (to be) lets out a cry. She must be happy, right? Feeling pleased, I stroke her even more.
“I’ve recalled memories from the future!”
I salute Father.
“The future? Didn’t that kick from Filo drive you crazy?”
“That’s not it. I’m the Love Hunter who has awakened to the knowledge of the future—the truth!”
Oh, I can remember it quite clearly. I took down the one who caused the upheaval and worked alongside Father to rebuild the world. I also spent every day having fun with Lady Filolial and the others.
……Hmm? Was there something beyond that? I can’t quite recall. But no matter what happened, I haven’t forgotten this.
It’s Filo-tan. Ah, Filo-tan… why are you Filo-tan? It seems I’ve ended up in a loop once again.
I check my spear.
True Minute Hand of the Dragon Hourglass 0/300 LR Abilities Unlocked… Equipment Bonus, Abilities: “Time Reversal,” “Selective Reversal,” “Random Reversal” Exclusive Effect: Parallel World Branches
Oh? The Minute Hand of the Dragon Hourglass has been powered up. And it seems to have an active skill as well. I wonder what it is?
Well, more importantly, this is a stroke of luck. Tomorrow morning, I’ll be able to see Filo-tan in her angelic form!
“Father, please give me your daughter.”
“Father? Daughter? What on earth are you talking about!?”
Hmm? Is it not getting through?
“Please let me have Filo-tan.”
“Filo…? So, Motoyasu… are you trying to take even her away from me! That won’t fly!”
Hmm? It seems Father has gotten something wrong.
“Let me rephrase that. Father, I’d like you to let me join your group.”

In this situation, wouldn’t it be possible for me to travel with you and help out in various ways? Since I’m already with her Older Sister, Filo-tan’s birth is a certainty, and I can just use my power to slaughter all our enemies.
“Huh? The Hero will resist, won’t he? —And don’t even joke about being an ally!”
Father is glaring at Crimson Swine. Crimson Swine is standing a little ways away, wary of Filo-tan.
“Do you even know what you did to me?”
“…Of course I do. It’s all my fault.”
It’s all my fault that I was tricked by Crimson Swine and cornered Father—I’ll do anything to atone for that sin.
“You admitted it pretty easily there…”
“What would it take for you to forgive me?”
“Hmm…”
Father is glaring at Crimson Swine. Ah, is that it? I’d do that even without being told, but if that’s what it takes for Father to believe me, I’ll do it right here and now.
“Understood. Once I’ve done this, you’ll let me join your group, right?”
“Huh?”
I turn around and beckon to Crimson Swine as I walk toward her.
“Oink, oink, oink?”
Crimson Swine and one of his henchmen… Oh? Lazy Pig has stopped for some reason and is backing away. Well, fine by me. I put all my strength into the spear and thrust it straight at Crimson Swine.
“Oink!?”
The spear pierced the Crimson Swine’s chest with a thud.
“Oiiiiiiink!?”
Henchman #1 let out some kind of cry. As for the Crimson Swine, she’s now disgustingly stuck to the spear.
“You’re so noisy! It’s all your fault Father had to go through such a terrible ordeal! Vanish from this world!”
I put all my strength into the spear… Ah, I must crush even its soul. I’ll transform it into the Soul Eater Spear and unleash it.
“Brionac X!”
“Oink—…!?”
“Biiiiii—…!?”
I wiped both the Crimson Swine and Henchman #1 off the face of the earth. Hahaha! This kind of end suits you lot just fine.
“I did it!”

I gave Father a thumbs-up. It looked like he and the others were staring at me in stunned silence, but I’m sure that’s just my imagination. After all, it was Father who gave the order to take them down!
“Oink!”
The Lazy Pig took advantage of the opening, turned his back, and bolted. I won’t let her get away!

Just as I was about to give chase, I heard a thudding sound coming from behind me. When I looked, I saw Filo-tan making a racket as she tried to drive off with Father on board. Tch! That lazy pig! It just got a lucky break. I chased after Father. At my high level, it’s not like I can’t keep up with that speed.
“Wait a minute, Father—”
“Don’t come after me! You’re just trying to pin this on me again, aren’t you!”
“That’s not it at all—Crimson Swine is just trash that doesn’t deserve to exist in this world, and I only eliminated her on your orders, Father. I want you to let me join your party.”
“How can I trust you!”
“I want you to believe me! Of course, I’ll tell you everything I know about the future. Everything—from how to enhance weapons to how to level up.”
“Guaaaaaaaah!?”
“Filo-ooon! I want you to accept my love!”
And so, my new journey began. My love is eternaaaaaaaaaaaaaal, I say!
